title: Topic 4.4: Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers

pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 4.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: CLASS READERS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.4: Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how the main characters make the story flow. What would you consider when selecting a storybook to read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main characters in a text
2. explain how the characters make the story flow

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main characters in a text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main characters in a text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain how the characters make the story flow
   In simple words: practise until you can explain how the characters make the story flow. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers.
4. Show that you can: identify the main characters in a text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 4.4.1 Intensive Reading: Class Readers important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a section of a class reader and identify the main characters,
2. Discuss predictions made from the title and the sections read,
3. Participate in a reader’s theatre and read portions of the class reader,
4. Discuss how the characters make the story flow,
5. Learning to learn:It is developed as the learner shares ideas on how the characters make the story flow.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main characters in a text
2. explain how the characters make the story flow

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
